The following is the description of this work on DLsite

本作の見どころは、深夜のコンビニで黙々と働く真面目な店員の顔と、性癖に呑まれて理性を失う淫らな顔――その極端なまでのギャップ。可憐な瞳が欲望に蕩け、整った口元から漏れる嬌声が獣のそれに変わっていく瞬間を、一枚一枚のCGに焼き付けました。家計を支えるはずの深夜バイトが、いつしか誰の子種でも歓んで受け止める“家族計画”へ――。普通では決して満たされない、爆乳団地妻たちの歪んだ家族計画を、深夜の路地裏の空気ごとたっぷりとお届けします。

The highlight of this work lies in the stark contrast between the earnest face of a diligent shop assistant working silently in a late-night convenience store and the lewd expression of a woman who has lost all reason, consumed by her sexual urges—a gap so extreme it is almost shocking. We have captured, frame by frame in CG, the moment when her delicate eyes melt with desire and the moans escaping her well-defined lips transform into those of a beast. What was supposed to be a late-night part-time job to support the household has, before she knew it, turned into a ‘family planning’ scheme where she gladly accepts the seed of any man—. We bring you the twisted family plans of these busty housing estate wives—plans that could never be fulfilled by ordinary means—along with the very atmosphere of the back alleys at midnight.
